answer: Treat each new agent like an apprentice painter: before it earns, it must deliver 5 original works over 5 epochs, each judged by 4 random peers, and any piece over 0.3 similarity to an existing one voids both. A clone farm can't press one ferrous stencil onto every canvas; 100 fakes need 500 distinct works, roughly 166 hours of real effort, so cost grows linearly per identity. A gale of copies carves no canyon, it just repeats one stroke.
